parallels.text: But since he has no root, he remains for only a season. When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, he quickly falls away.
Then Jesus said to them, “This very night you will all fall away on account of Me. For it is written: ‘I will strike the Shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’
Peter said to Him, “Even if all fall away on account of You, I never will.”
Do not be afraid of those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul. Instead, fear the One who can destroy both soul and body in hell.
So be on your guard; I have told you everything in advance.
Blessed are you when people hate you, and when they exclude you and insult you and reject your name as evil because of the Son of Man.

crossrefs.text: and, “A stone of stumbling and a rock of offense.” They stumble because they disobey the word—and to this they were appointed.
His parents said this because they were afraid of the Jews. For the Jews had already determined that anyone who confessed Jesus as the Christ would be put out of the synagogue.
So then, I too was convinced that I ought to do all I could to oppose the name of Jesus of Nazareth.
I frequently had them punished in the synagogues, and I tried to make them blaspheme. In my raging fury against them, I even went to foreign cities to persecute them.
And now I have told you before it happens, so that when it does happen, you will believe.
“Lord, where are You going?” Simon Peter asked. Jesus answered, “Where I am going, you cannot follow Me now, but you will follow later.”
But they will treat you like this because of My name, since they do not know the One who sent Me.
For I testify about them that they are zealous for God, but not on the basis of knowledge.

parallels.text: And behold, I am sending the promise of My Father upon you. But remain in the city until you have been clothed with power from on high.”
All things have been entrusted to Me by My Father. No one knows the Son except the Father, and no one knows the Father except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal Him.

crossrefs.text: But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, will teach you all things and will remind you of everything I have told you.
But God has revealed it to us by the Spirit. The Spirit searches all things, even the deep things of God.
And this is what we speak, not in words taught us by human wisdom, but in words taught by the Spirit, expressing spiritual truths in spiritual words.
the Spirit of truth. The world cannot receive Him, because it neither sees Him nor knows Him. But you do know Him, for He abides with you and will be in you.
But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, will teach you all things and will remind you of everything I have told you.
When the Advocate comes, whom I will send to you from the Father—the Spirit of truth who proceeds from the Father—He will testify about Me.

And as for you, the anointing you received from Him remains in you, and you do not need anyone to teach you. But just as His true and genuine anointing teaches you about all things, so remain in Him as you have been taught.
You, however, have an anointing from the Holy One, and all of you know the truth.

crossrefs.text: If you remain in Me and My words remain in you, ask whatever you wish, and it will be done for you.
And I will do whatever you ask in My name, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
If you ask Me for anything in My name, I will do it.
Consider it pure joy, my brothers, when you encounter trials of many kinds,
Even before they call, I will answer, and while they are still speaking, I will hear.
You crave what you do not have; you kill and covet, but are unable to obtain it. You quarrel and fight. You do not have, because you do not ask.
And when you do ask, you do not receive, because you ask with wrong motives, that you may squander it on your pleasures.
And this is the confidence that we have before Him: If we ask anything according to His will, He hears us.

crossrefs.text: Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled; do not be afraid.
because everyone born of God overcomes the world. And this is the victory that has overcome the world: our faith.
Now may the Lord of peace Himself give you peace at all times and in every way. The Lord be with all of you.
You, little children, are from God and have overcome them, because greater is He who is in you than he who is in the world.
And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.
